title: The chosen approximate tangent plane equals any approximate tangent plane
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, x ∈ ℝ^P and Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P. If Q is an approximate tangent space of M at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q: dim Q = n and ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dH^n → ∫_Q f dH^n as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), with η_{x,r}(y) = r^{-1}(y − x) and H^n = μHE[n]), then approxTangentPlane n M x = Q, where approxTangentPlane n M x is the contract's choice: a chosen plane Q' with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q' if such a plane exists, and ⊥ otherwise.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → approxTangentPlane n M x = Q
